## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src.b2d8b5d8"></a>**1. AppModule is the application's root NestJS module: it imports the config, cache, upload, jobs, parser, auth, calendar, and health feature modules, declares AppController as its only controller, and provides AppService.**
  [`app.module.ts:17-50`](../app.module.ts#L17-L50)
- <a id="research.backend-src.46f509a2"></a>**2. AppModule configures global rate limiting by importing ThrottlerModule.forRoot with a 60,000 ms TTL and a limit of 100 requests, and registers CustomThrottlerGuard as the global APP_GUARD provider.**
  [`app.module.ts:21-27`](../app.module.ts#L21-L27)
  [`app.module.ts:38-42`](../app.module.ts#L38-L42)
- <a id="research.backend-src.cf249a5a"></a>**3. AppModule registers LoggingInterceptor as the global APP_INTERCEPTOR provider so that every request is logged with request and user IDs.**
  [`app.module.ts:43-47`](../app.module.ts#L43-L47)
- <a id="research.backend-src.c2aad9fb"></a>**4. The bootstrap function creates the Nest application from AppModule, sets the Express 'trust proxy' flag, enables Helmet security middleware, configures an express-session with a 24-hour cookie that is secure in production, and initializes Passport.**
  [`main.ts:12-38`](../main.ts#L12-L38)
- <a id="research.backend-src.a6d50bb5"></a>**5. bootstrap installs a global HttpExceptionFilter, a global QueryTimeoutInterceptor with a 60-second timeout, and a global ValidationPipe with whitelist, forbidNonWhitelisted, and transform enabled.**
  [`main.ts:66-86`](../main.ts#L66-L86)
- <a id="research.backend-src.5f8caa7a"></a>**6. bootstrap builds Swagger documentation titled 'Tuks Schedule Generator API' with Google OAuth2 and bearer authentication, serves it at /api/docs, and listens on the configured port (default 3001) on 0.0.0.0.**
  [`main.ts:88-114`](../main.ts#L88-L114)
- <a id="research.backend-src.dcf1a38e"></a>**7. AppController is a root-level NestJS controller that exposes a GET endpoint whose getHello method returns the greeting produced by AppService.**
  [`app.controller.ts:4-12`](../app.controller.ts#L4-L12)
- <a id="research.backend-src.83908882"></a>**8. AppService is an injectable NestJS service whose getHello method returns the string 'Hello World!'.**
  [`app.service.ts:3-8`](../app.service.ts#L3-L8)
- <a id="research.backend-src.d9944d03"></a>**9. bootstrap enables CORS for the configured frontend URL and the deployed frontend origins, allowing requests without an origin and localhost origins outside production, with credentials enabled.**
  [`main.ts:40-64`](../main.ts#L40-L64)
